_comment: Folio's features. Tools/setup/folio.py reads this to build a new vault (new) or change one (add / remove). paths: files or folders copied with the feature (a folder means every tracked file under it); skills: LLM/skills/<name> plus its stubs in each agent folder, and its row in the AGENTS.md command table; plugins / snippets / core_plugins: Obsidian settings switched with the feature; config: keys of LLM/vault_config.json that only this feature uses; requires: features added with it. template_only: never copied into a vault.

core.title: Core
core.about: Status list, current work, topic notes, day rollover, git rules, the Obsidian look

cmd-sync: Update Today / Yesterday / Ongoing in `DEV_STATUS.md` from the chat
cmd-rollover: Today → Yesterday (and the journal day note when the vault has one), commit
cmd-features: List, add or remove this vault's features
git-workflow: Git and merge-request rules for the project repos

test-queue.title: Test queue
test-queue.about: One test checklist per branch, ticked as results come in; for work tested by hand or on hardware

plan.title: Phases
plan.about: A phase plan; /cmd-phase records a phase that passed on its target (phone, board, staging) before the next starts

cmd-phase: A phase of `Quest/Plan.md` passed on its target: record it first, then start the next

archive.title: Notes sync and archive
archive.about: /cmd-notes-sync fixes notes that disagree with the code and moves finished Ongoing items to PROGRESS_ARCHIVE.md

cmd-notes-sync: Fix stale vault notes, move `[x]` Ongoing items to `PROGRESS_ARCHIVE.md`

docs.title: Spec / Impl / Reference
docs.about: Folders for wire formats and protocols (Spec), one note per module (Impl) and background reading (Reference)

journal.title: Journal
journal.about: Day and week notes (Templater, Calendar); /cmd-journal and /cmd-report write Traditional Chinese summaries in your tone (TONE.md)

cmd-journal: Chinese journal bullets in the day note, tone learning
cmd-report: Three Chinese parts in the week note

weekly-report.title: Weekly report
weekly-report.about: WEEKLY_REPORT.md in Traditional Chinese and a filled company Word .doc (Word on Windows, reached from WSL)

cmd-word-report: Run the weekly report tool, commit and push the vault

diagrams.title: Diagrams
diagrams.about: Dark theme for every Mermaid type, the mermaid-diagrams skill for the agent, a headless preview tool

mermaid-diagrams: Which Mermaid type to use, readability, theme classes

screens.title: Screens
screens.about: App screens laid out on phone frames with the Vellum plugin, in a JSON the agent builds from
